title: Champagne Brand Ambassador (H/F)
mission_profile:
Position : Brand Ambassador
The Brand Ambassador will play a key role in expanding our presence in Germany and the neighboring countries. You will maintain strong relationships with existing clients, and identify new business opportunities with potential customers. Our business is strictly B2B, with clients being fine wine distributors, some with a retail activity. You will also be in close relationship with sommeliers and restaurant/hotel managers.
Key Responsibilities : 
• Visit and maintain relationships with existing customers in your territory. 
• Meet potential customers to introduce our wines.
• Support our partners and create brand awareness through staff trainings and targeted events. 
• Accompany professionals willing to visit the vineyards and the cellar in Reims.
• Coordinate with the team in Reims, contributing to overall sales strategy and planning. 
Work Schedule : 
This position follows a rotating cycle between
• days traveling (customer visits and prospecting), about 80% of the time, a field-oriented mission!
• days working from the office to prepare reports, plan next tour, discuss sales planning with the team and so on. 
• some events can happen during weekends.
• you will have a close follow-up of your activities with the Export Manager twice a week, and meetings on regular bases.
Location : Frankfurt
The base location chosen shall enable you to travel easily and cover your territory properly, Germany being the main market to develop.
Driver's licence required.
